subject: Assignment handoff, submission window, and reviewer coordination
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Reyes <jordan.reyes+ri@gmail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Assignment handoff: backend coding prompt + timeline

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for speaking with us yesterday. As discussed, attached is the backend coding assignment we use for mid-senior backend candidates. The high-level ask: implement a small service that ingests a stream of events, supports a simple query API, and includes a lightweight correctness test suite. Expect ~3–5 hours of focused work.

Deliverables and deadline
- What we want: a GitHub repo (public or private) with code, README, and instructions to run tests.
- Deadline: 72 hours from receipt (submit by Fri, Aug 28 09:12 PT). If you need an extension, please request it before the deadline.

Attachments: backend-coding-assignment.pdf (prompt + sample tests)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcExampleAssignmentFolder

Next steps on our side: I’ve CC’d the interviewers (Marissa and Karthik) and Laura (hiring manager). We’ll schedule a 45-minute review slot within 48 hours of your submission to go over notes and scoring.

If anything is unclear about the prompt or environment, reply here and I’ll loop in dev contacts. Good luck — looking forward to reviewing.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

---
Note: please attach the completed repo link in a reply or email to this thread so we can track the submission in our hiring tracker.
